response.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') SELECT qp.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) as avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_HCT FROM qualifying_patients qp JOIN Patient p ON qp.ID = p.ID JOIN Laboratory l ON qp.ID = l.ID GROUP BY qp.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10
